modifier_semantics.timesfm_short: only when baseline requests short; specialist disagreement is timesfm_point_return >= 0; half maps -1 to -0.5 and veto maps -1 to 0
modifier_semantics.kronos_long: only when baseline requests long; specialist disagreement is kronos_close_return <= 0; half maps +1 to +0.5 and veto maps +1 to 0
modifier_semantics.kronos_path: only on the frozen 96-origin native-path sample; disagreement is pred_terminal_return sign versus baseline requested sign; half reduces absolute position by half; absent sample rows are neutral
modifier_semantics.timesfm_uncertainty: raw next-settlement q10/q90 coverage is not five-session calibration; high uncertainty may halve size only after prior-OOS evidence establishes a positive relationship between TimesFM interval width and five-session absolute baseline forecast error

chronology.selection_rule: for each outer block, score configurations only on complete yearly OOS blocks ending before that outer block begins; freeze one configuration before scoring the outer block
chronology.adaptive_history_boundary: Phase-4 hypotheses were discovered on development evidence; Phase-5 results remain adaptive-development evidence, not clean historical confirmation

uncertainty_calibration.association: Spearman correlation between TimesFM interval width and absolute five-session baseline forecast error on prior OOS records only
uncertainty_calibration.activation_rule: correlation must be finite and > 0; otherwise the uncertainty modifier is neutral
uncertainty_calibration.high_threshold: 75th percentile of TimesFM interval width in the same prior OOS calibration records
uncertainty_calibration.fit_frequency: once at each policy evaluation block boundary; frozen within the block

selection.risk_policy: phase1_standard_ng_v0 unchanged; standard replay determines selection score
selection.continuous_replay_role: mandatory diagnostic only, never a substitute selection target
selection.failed_configuration_policy: retain with reason and exclude from selection
